content: 1. Administer 5 mg of the medication orally in the morning. Subsequently, take one elagolix 300 mg capsule orally in the evening. The treatment duration must not exceed 24 months. Ensure pregnancy is excluded prior to initiating therapy or begin treatment within 7 days of the onset of menses. 2. The use of elagolix is limited to a maximum of 24 months due to the risk of continued bone loss, which may be irreversible. 3. Ceftobiprole medocaril sodium increases the plasma concentration of elagolix by inhibiting OATP1B1/1B3 transporters. Concomitant use is contraindicated. 4. Clotrimazole increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. 5. Cyclosporine increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. 6. Encorafenib increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use is contraindicated. 7. Erythromycin (base, ethylsuccinate, lactobionate, stearate) increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. 8. Gemfibrozil increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. 9. Glecaprevir/pibrentasvir increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. 10. Lenvatinib increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. 11. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of lonafarnib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Concomitant use is contraindicated as lonafarnib is a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate. 12. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of mavacamten by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Concomitant use is contraindicated. 13. Ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir and dasabuvir increase the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use is contraindicated due to OATP1B1/1B3 inhibition. 14. Pazopanib increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. 15. Ritonavir increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. 16. Tacrolimus increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. 17. Telmisartan increases the level or effect of elagolix. Concomitant use with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. 18. Acitretin decreases the effects of norethindrone acetate through an unknown mechanism. Concomitant use is contraindicated due to the risk of contraceptive failure. 19. Apalutamide decreases the level or effect of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Concomitant use with CYP3A4 substrates may reduce their therapeutic efficacy. 20. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of avapritinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 21. Belzutifan decreases the level or effect of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Concomitant use with hormonal contraceptives may lead to contraceptive failure or increased breakthrough bleeding. Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective nonhormonal contraception. 22. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of capivasertib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 23. Carbamazepine decreases the level or effect of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Hormonal contraceptives are not reliable during coadministration. 24. Ceritinib increases the level or effect of elagolix by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 25. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of daridorexant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 26. Dienogest/estradiol valerate decreases the effects of elagolix through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 27. Ethinylestradiol decreases the effects of elagolix through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 28. Fexinidazole increases the level or effect of norethindrone acetate and elagolix by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 29. Elagolix increases the level or effect of finerenone by inhibiting CYP2E1 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 30. Fosphenytoin decreases the level or effect of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 31. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of fruquintinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 32. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of ganaxolone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 33. Grapefruit increases the level or effect of elagolix by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 34. Idelalisib increases the level or effect of norethindrone acetate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 35. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of infigratinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 36. Ivosidenib decreases the level or effect of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 37. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of lefamulin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 38. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of lemborexant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 39. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of lenacapavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 40. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of leniolisib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 41. Levonorgestrel (oral, transdermal, or intrauterine) decreases the effects of elagolix through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 42. Lumacaftor/ivacaftor decreases the level or effect of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 43. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of lumateperone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 44. Elagolix decreases the level or effect of lurbinectedin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 45. Mavacamten decreases the level or effect of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 46. Mestranol decreases the effects of elagolix through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 47. Mitotane decreases the level or effect of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug.
